sources.name: International Blueberry Organization website news (Africa items)

dated weather impacts (May 2026 Western Cape floods: some growers lost over 70% of volume; 300-400 mm in 2-3 days)
app_uses: event and practice records between IBO report editions

verification.note: Nov 2025 item read for country hectares; the Aug 2026 South Africa item was read through its FreshFruitPortal republication (https://www.freshfruitportal.com/news/2026/08/31/sa-blueberry-weather/).

sources.priority_reason: Fills gaps between annual IBO editions with dated events.

rag_jobs.title: Steyn 2022 dated stage table for Hex River and Wolseley
fields_mapped: stage (50% flowering, 90% flowering, first harvest, peak harvest, pruning, hives in, hives out)
rag_jobs.review_needed: Confirm which table dates belong to which site; Table 1 (carbohydrate chapter) is Hex River 2020 and 2021. Check that first-harvest dates by site are read from the reproductive chapter, not the abstract.
rag_jobs.licensing_gate: Thesis terms not stated on the bitstream; display short factual dates with citation; confirm SUNScholar reuse terms before showing figures.
rag_jobs.app_value: First dated, cultivar-specific calibration points in Africa; lets the evergreen managed cycle start from late-November pruning at Wolseley.

rag_jobs.title: Western Cape WCDoA station pull for benchmark and trial sites
rag_jobs.cadence: one-off backfill for Veldreserwe, George PP and Elsenburg, then weekly
rag_jobs.review_needed: Check archive start per station; flag the portal's 'not verified' status; compare against MERRA-2 cell for Tmin bias and frost nights (for example 29 Aug 2024 -1.93 C).
rag_jobs.licensing_gate: Portal says data are unverified and only SAWS data are official; ask DOA.GIS@westerncape.gov.za before republishing raw series; derived bias statistics are lower risk.
rag_jobs.app_value: Station-based Tmin bias and frost detection at two benchmark sites; leaf wetness for disease indices.

rag_jobs.title: SASSCAL Mashare and Bagani station pull for Kavango frosts
rag_jobs.cadence: one-off backfill 2012 to present, then monthly
rag_jobs.review_needed: Identify the frost nights in winter 2023 and 2024 and link them to the IBO event na-kavango-frost-2023-2024 as a new event record with day precision.
rag_jobs.licensing_gate: No licence stated; contact SASSCAL before public display of raw values.
rag_jobs.app_value: Turns an undated IBO frost narrative into dated, measured frost events and tests why the grid cell misses them.

rag_jobs.title: Zimbabwe MSD dekadal bulletins to station table and frost events
rag_jobs.cadence: one-off backfill 2024 to 2026, then every dekad
rag_jobs.review_needed: Treat 'E' as missing; check column alignment per PDF; keep narrative frost lists as event records with dekad precision.
rag_jobs.licensing_gate: Terms not found; ask MSD before redistributing tables; citing bulletin facts is low risk.
rag_jobs.app_value: Free station minima at Marondera for chill and frost checks; dated wet-season ends for harvest rain.

rag_jobs.title: Monthly trade-mirror arrival curves for African origins
rag_jobs.cadence: one-off backfill 2015 to present, then monthly
rag_jobs.review_needed: Apply a shipping-lag assumption per route and test it; separate South African imports from Zimbabwe (June peak) from Zimbabwe's exports to Europe (September to October peak).
rag_jobs.licensing_gate: Eurostat (source acknowledgement) and OGL v3.0 allow display with attribution; check UN Comtrade and SARS terms before showing their numbers.
rag_jobs.app_value: Year-by-year harvest-timing proxy for Zimbabwe, Namibia, Zambia, Egypt and South Africa; settles the Zimbabwe peak conflict.
